meta_description:
7,154 likes, 34 comments - beebomco on October 5, 2026: "Here Are THE BEST Deals on The Amazon Great Indian Festival!

The iPhone 16 comes with the A18 chip, a 6.1 inch display and a 48MP main camera. It is available during the festival for ₹74,999.

The Apple Watch Series 11 46mm comes with the S10 chip, an Always-On Retina display and strong battery life. It usually costs ₹49,900, and during the festival it is available for ₹37,999, with an additional ₹2,000 bank discount.

The MacBook Neo comes with the A18 Pro chip, a 13 inch Liquid Retina display and a full aluminium build. It is usually priced at ₹72,990 and is discounted during the festival.

The Xiaomi Pad 8 comes with an 11 inch display and the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 processor, along with the Focus Pen Pro. It usually sells for ₹51,999, and during the festival it is available for ₹47,999, going down to ₹42,999 with instant bank offers.

The Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra comes with the Snapdragon 8 Elite for Galaxy, a 2K AMOLED display with anti-reflective coating and a 200MP main camera. It normally sells for ₹99,999, and during the festival it is available for ₹84,999.

The OnePlus Nord 6 comes with a 165Hz AMOLED display, the Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chip and a 9000mAh battery. It is getting a discount of ₹4,000 and is available for ₹42,999.

Additional SBI bank discounts and No Cost EMI options are available on more smartphones on the Amazon India app. 

#AmazonGreatIndianFestival #AmazonIndia".
